answer: Someone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The marble counter is kept in nadir and horizon shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4695 identities would post 4937 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
